alias: Cinema Studio · Autoprueba de selección (sin dispositivos)
description: Ejecuta el bloque de selección nuevo con dry_run en ambos servicios. No escribe helpers, no llama cinema_registrar, no toca dispositivos ni historial. Devuelve las variables resultantes.

variables.coleccion: {% set season = states('sensor.temporada_de_cine_activa') %}{% set known = state_attr('sensor.active_collection','collection_priorities') or {} %}{{ season if season in known else 'regular' }}

sequence.alias: Cinema Studio: inicializar variables de selección

else.alias: Cinema Studio: seleccionar clip (offline, contrato v1)

variables.nuevo_ok: {% set r = nuevo if nuevo is mapping else {} %}{% set cid = r.get('clip_id') %}{% set uri = r.get('media_content_id') %}{% set col = r.get('collection_id') %}{% set name = r.get('title') or r.get('source_name') or cid %}{% set d = r.get('duration') %}{% set ds = r.get('duration_seconds') %}{% set s = r.get('content_start_offset') %}{% set e = r.get('content_end_offset') %}{% set l = r.get('lead_in_duration') %}{% set t = r.get('tail_out_duration') %}{% set cd = r.get('content_duration') %}{% set tol = 0.0010001 %}{% set ids_ok = cid is string and cid | length > 0 and uri is string and col is string and col | length > 0 and name is string and name | length > 0 %}{% set uri_ok = ids_ok and uri.startswith('media-source://media_source/local/cinema-studio/renders/' ~ cid ~ '/') %}{% set nums_ok = (d is number and d is not boolean and d == d and (d) | abs < 100000) and (ds is number and ds is not boolean and ds == ds and (ds) | abs < 100000) and (s is number and s is not boolean and s == s and (s) | abs < 100000) and (e is number and e is not boolean and e == e and (e) | abs < 100000) and (l is number and l is not boolean and l == l and (l) | abs < 100000) and (t is number and t is not boolean and t == t and (t) | abs < 100000) and (cd is number and cd is not boolean and cd == cd and (cd) | abs < 100000) %}{{ (r.get('contract_version') == 1 and r.get('timing_verified') is sameas true and r.get('file_verified') is sameas true and ids_ok and uri_ok and nums_ok and ds == d and 0 < d <= 7200 and 0 <= s and s < e and e <= d and (s - l) | abs <= tol and (d - e - t) | abs <= tol and ((e - s) - cd) | abs <= tol) is sameas true }}

then.alias: Cinema Studio: mapear respuesta a variables del script

variables.clip_nombre: {{ (seleccion or {}).get('title') or (seleccion or {}).get('source_name') or ((seleccion or {}).get('relative_output_path') or '').split('/')[-1] }}

if.value_template: {{ not timing.get('ok',false) or timing.get('clip_id') != clip_id or timing.get('relative_output_path') != seleccion.get('relative_output_path') }}

sequence.alias: Cinema Studio con respaldo verbatim a Cinema Collections
